The '''Metalorn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]].
